## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `09f66fe6af573878c58b64265d0c9dc9f501c98e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (widened: content/docs/data-modeling/relationships.mdx, content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx, the changeset)
Security-touching: yes

Inputs: card #34201 (body and its five comments, claim 6922776400 and dev report 6933361559 included), the PR body, handoff 6933409231, the net diff against `main` (merge base `9e6fee19ea`, 5 files, +118/−9), the check-runs on this head. Read at this head, outside the diff: `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupRecordReference.ts`, `LookupField.tsx`, `RecordPickerDialog.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` and `sectionFields.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`. No earlier record on this PR. `Security-touching: yes`: one hunk edits the `secret` row (credential-storage guidance) and the new paragraph teaches that the picker filter is not a save-time control.

### ① Derived judgments

- `{ $record: 'field' }` and one hop `{ $record: 'account.market' }`, at most one dot: right. `LOOKUP_FILTER_RECORD_PATH_RE` admits one dot and refuses a second at parse; `readRecordPath` splits at the first dot, reads the hop row (expanded on the record, or one `findOne` per lookup id) and would leave a deeper path out.
- "Only a record form resolves it; every other picker host leaves the entry out": right. Resolution is opt-in on the stamp `withRecordBeingEdited` writes, and its only callers are `ObjectForm.tsx` and `sectionFields.ts` (modal, drawer and section layouts go through the latter). `LookupField` reads `NO_EDITED_RECORD` without the stamp; `bulkParamToField.ts` strips it; `lookupFiltersToRecord` drops any reference still unresolved.
- Empty or unreadable value drops the entry: right (`resolveLookupFilters` pushes only a defined value; a hop that cannot be read answers undefined).
- `orEmpty: true` also matches a null column, with the same six operators: right. `refuseMalformedLookupFilterEntry` refuses `orEmpty` (either value) and a `$record` value on `contains`, `in`, `notIn` at parse; the picker sends `$or` of the condition and `$null` on the same column.
- `dependsOn` adds an equality filter: right (`dependentFilter` sets `param = value`, and the picker is gated while the parent is empty, as the docs pages say).
- `os validate` refuses an unknown path (relationships.mdx): right. `object-field-ref-unknown` has an owner-addressed `lookupFilters[].value.$record` position, `maxHops: 1`, severity error.
- "The picker only narrows the choice: a rule the save must enforce belongs on the server too": right, and it is the spec describe's own closing sentence. No write path reads `lookupFilters`; the only server reader of `$record` refuses it. No taught sentence presents the filter as an access or validation control.
- The five cuts: each fact keeps a home in the same file (the `password` row's "Prefer `secret` for credentials"; the Autonumber token table; the paragraph "The counter resets per scope"; rule 3's heading). No rule is dropped.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, on the PR body and in the changeset: right. Published skill wording only; no accept set, schema or code changes. The changeset's account matches the diff sentence for sentence.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs: none red. `Test Core (1/8)` and `(2/8)` were still in progress at the time of reading; every other run is success or skipped (`Build Docs`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec property liveness` included). Landing waits for the two shards.
- Ceiling raise 3349 → 3553: sizes read from the tree, 13395 → 14210 bytes (net +815; lines added 1643 bytes, removed 828), `ceil(14210 / 4)` = 3553, pinned at the measurement, no other row moved. Same-file deletion is shown and the body quotes the standing ruling and record 6513306068, the gate-recognised path the script header names.
- Landing tier: H. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is outside `LOW_RISK_RIDER_PATTERNS`, so `lowRiskArmVerdict` answers "a path outside skills wording and prose" whatever this record says; the line above reads `yes` as well. The maintainer lands it, as the body says.
- Deviation "ratchet script outside the order's file surface": accepted by the lane seat before the push; it is the row the taught file's ceiling lives in.
- Dev note "`content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` does not mention `{ $record }`, carrier: none": a gap, nothing wrong is taught there. The lane seat files it or names it in its ACCEPT.
- Human Minimum item 3 left unticked for the repo-wide lint: the lint check-runs on this head are green.
- `open_questions`: none. SQL push-down: not applicable, no code.

### ④ Design judgment

`field-types.md` § Lookup, sentence by sentence against the readers and the spec at this head: every sentence holds (see ①). The example parses under `refuseMalformedLookupFilterEntry` (three scalar operators, references as whole values, `orEmpty` on `lte` and `eq`). Tried to break it: a two-hop path (refused at parse and by the lint rule; left out by the reader), `orEmpty` beside `in` (refused at parse), a reference on a non-form host that passes values (no stamp, left out), a referenced field also in `dependsOn` (equality filter plus gate, as taught), an author reading the filter as a save rule (the last sentence says otherwise). Against the card's four points (shape, empty value, `orEmpty` and its six operators, `dependsOn` or `$record`): all four are taught, once each.

`check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: one row and its comment; the comment's arithmetic and homes agree with the tree.

N1 (nit) — `fields.mdx`, the new section omits the sentence that the picker only narrows the choice; it reaches the reader through the link to the relationships page, and the table row already says "picker-honored".

N2 (nit) — the reader also treats an empty list as an empty value (`isEmptyValue`); the docs list null, unset, an empty string and an unset hop, the same list the spec describe gives.

No must-fix. No open should-fix.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`objectstack-data` 技能的 `rules/field-types.md` 和两页数据建模文档（`relationships.mdx`、`fields.mdx`）开始教 lookup 筛选里的 `{ $record }` 引用和 `orEmpty`：引用怎么写（字段或最多一跳）、引用值为空时这条筛选被略过、`orEmpty` 和它能搭配的六个运算符、它和 `dependsOn` 的区别。
- **为什么改**：这两个写法的读取方（表单里的记录选择器）已随 PR #34253 落地，活性账本记为 live，规范里的「PLANNED」标记也已摘掉，但技能和文档一个字都没提，AI 和作者不知道可以按当前记录筛选候选项。
- **风险与回滚**：只改技能和文档文字，不动产品代码。技能文件原本零余量，先删同文件 5 处重复（179 字节），再按裁决 6513306068 把该文件的 token 上限按实测从 3349 提到 3553。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` 的 Lookup 段（新例子加一段说明），然后是 `relationships.mdx` 新增的一节。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep field-types`，预期 `3553 / 3553 (+0)`，末行 ✓。
- **需要你做的**：受管路径（`skills/**`，Tier H）。契约审核 PASS 记录 6933533087，`Head-sha: 09f66fe6af573878c58b64265d0c9dc9f501c98e`。请审阅并合并（或在此 head 上批准，由席位落地）。
- **席位意见**：建议合并。教的每句都对得上选择器代码和 spec，例子能通过解析；最后一句明确「选择器只缩小候选，保存时的规则仍要放在服务端」，不会被读成权限控制。
